### Strive Announces Proposed Initial Public Offering of SATS Stock


October 13, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/435279266/files/doc_news/Strive-Announces-Proposed-Initial-Public-Offering-of-SATS-Stock-2026.pdf)


DALLAS, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced that, subject to market and other conditions, it intends to conduct an initial public offering (the “offering”) registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), of 5,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “SATS Stock”).


Strive intends to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, including, among other things, the acquisition of bitcoin and bitcoin-related products and for working capital, the purchase of income generating assets to grow the Company’s business, other capital expenditures, and/or repurchases of shares of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Class A Common Stock”) or its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “SATA Stock”). Strive may also use such proceeds to fund acquisitions of businesses, assets or technologies that complement its current business.


The SATS Stock will accumulate cumulative dividends at a rate per annum equal to 15.00% on the stated amount of $100 per share (the “stated amount”) thereof. Regular dividends on the SATS Stock will be payable when, as and if declared by Strive’s board of directors or any duly authorized committee thereof, out of funds legally available for their payment, in arrears on each payment date to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the regular record date immediately preceding the applicable regular dividend payment date. Regular dividend dates will fall on each business day, as defined in the governing documentation for the SATS Stock, beginning on November 9, 2026. If declared in full, the first scheduled regular dividend on the SATS Stock payable will include all accrued and unpaid dividends from and after the closing date.


At the closing of the offering, Strive intends to establish a dividend reserve in an amount equal to the first 18 months of dividend payments calculated as of the date of the offering by depositing an equivalent of $22.50 per share of SATS Stock into an account funded by us with a combination of existing cash on hand and securities held by us (based on the value of such securities at the closing of this offering).


Strive will have the right, at its election, to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock, at any time, for cash if the total number of shares of all SATS Stock then outstanding is less than 25% of the total number of shares of SATS Stock originally issued in this offering and in any future offering, taken together. In addition, Strive will have the right to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock if certain tax events occur. The redemption price for any SATS Stock to be redeemed will be a cash amount equal to the liquidation preference of the SATS Stock to be redeemed as of the business day before the date on which Strive sends the related redemption notice, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, thereon to, and including, the redemption date.


If an event that constitutes a “fundamental change” under the certificate of designation governing the SATS Stock occurs, then holders of the SATS Stock will have the right to require Strive to repurchase some or all of their shares of SATS Stock at a cash repurchase price equal to the stated amount of the SATS Stock to be repurchased, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, to, and including, the fundamental change repurchase date.


The liquidation preference of the SATS Stock will initially be $100 per share; provided, however, that, effective immediately after the close of business on each business day after the initial issue date (and, if applicable, during the course of a business day on which any sale transaction to be settled by the issuance of SATS Stock is executed, from the exact time of the first such sale transaction during such business day until the close of business of such business day), the liquidation preference per share of SATS Stock will be adjusted to be the greatest of (i) the stated amount per share of SATS Stock; (ii) in the case of any business day with respect to which Strive has, on such business day or any business day during the ten trading day period preceding such business day, executed any sale transaction to be settled by the issuance of SATS Stock, an amount equal to the last reported sale price per share of SATS Stock on the trading day immediately before such business day; and (iii) the arithmetic average of the last reported sale prices per share of SATS Stock for each trading day of the ten consecutive trading days (or, if applicable, the lesser number of trading days as have elapsed during the period from, and including, the initial issue date to, but excluding, such business day) immediately preceding such business day.


Barclays and Cantor are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering. Clear Street is acting as lead manager for the offering. B. Riley Securities, H.C. Wainwright & Co., Maxim Group LLC, and StoneX are acting as co-managers for the offering.


The offering is being made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on file with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The offering will be made only by means of a prospectus supplement and an accompanying prospectus. An electronic copy of the preliminary prospectus supplement, together with the accompanying prospectus, is available on the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov .](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=F1BXnnZEQsG6oxKn28vQXb0H38dfxSznxwcgASJ8pt34--BEGSz0CWaKXkRe447DVTqUh9AaY7vJsX8Rx3nARA==) Alternatively, copies of the preliminary prospectus supplement, together with the accompanying prospectus, can be obtained by contacting: Barclays Capital Inc., c/o Broadridge Financial Solutions, 1155 Long Island Avenue, Edgewood, NY 11717, by email at[barclaysprospectus@broadridge.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bVcndKjB6ie1p3p6_hy6098spppS-hTOs5qxjepx6utt8xOTKHaJEu95nuwSw_lpkbh3IXbgjjYcD5Tb8zAlnRQrkM5Der4z9W6kfUnn4gVqRLBDr1pO_Tgwz-8nQFBAbisdo28uw_4pVHWBV9xs2Q==) or telephone at 1-888-603-5847; or Cantor Fitzgerald & Co., Attention: Capital Markets, 110 East 59th Street, 6th Floor, New York, NY 10022, or by email atprospectus@cantor.com .


**About Strive**


Strive is a structured finance company focused on disciplined capital allocation and long term value creation. We have strategically adopted bitcoin as our hurdle rate for capital deployment because of our fiduciary duty to maximize long-term value for stockholders and compound purchasing power over time.


Strive Asset Management, LLC, a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Strive and an SEC-registered investment adviser, manages over $2.8 billion in assets.
